composition: Composition. Margins: 7-9% of the width on every side (80 px on a 1080 canvas); the safe zone is a floor, not the layout. Pick one grid (4 or 6 columns inside the margins, 8 px steps) and snap every edge to it. One alignment axis for the whole design: flush-left text blocks by default; centre only short, symmetrical compositions. One focal element covering 40-70% of the canvas, placed on a third (about 33% or 66% of the height), never dead centre by default. Plan the reading path (top-down or Z) through 3 groups at most: hook, message, action. Space inside a group is about half the space between groups. Keep at least 30% of the canvas calm (photo calm area or flat colour); empty space is a design element, do not fill it.
hierarchy: Hierarchy. One element wins at first glance (thumbnail test: at 270 px wide the message reads in one second). Scale contrast: the title is at least 3x the body size; use at most 3 text sizes from one ratio (x1.5: e.g. 36 / 54 / 80 / 120 / 180). Size, weight and colour each do one job: do not make the important thing bigger, bolder AND coloured. The call to action is specific (a verb + what you get), sized about 1.2x the body, placed last on the reading path; it needs no pill if position and contrast already make it obvious.
type: Type. At most 2 families: one with character for display, one neutral for text, clearly different (not two similar sans). Display sizes: line height 0.9-1.05, letter spacing -2% to -4%; text: line height 1.3-1.45, spacing 0. Titles: 2-4 words per line, break lines by meaning by hand, no single word alone on the last line. All caps only for 1-3 words, with +5% to +10% letter spacing. Never stretch, outline or shadow text to fix legibility: fix the background behind it instead. Body text never under 30 px on a 1080 canvas. Numbers in an offer (-20 %, 1st month free) can be the hero: set them huge. Tight grotesque display caps: weight 500 with letterSpacing about -5 % of the size; airy luxury caps: light weight (300) with +2 % to +3 %. Justified small paragraphs (editorial layouts): align 'justify' with no manual line breaks inside; set the box width and let the text wrap, since forced breaks are never justified.
color: Color. Build the colours from the subject or the photo (pick its dark, its light and one strong colour), not from a generic theme. Proportion 60 / 30 / 10: dominant, secondary, accent. The accent marks one thing only: the action or the key figure. Text contrast at least 4.5:1 (3:1 at 72 px and more), measured against what is really behind the text. Tint neutrals toward them (warm or cool greys, never pure #000 on #fff by reflex). Gradients only to carry light (a scrim that follows the photo's light), never as decoration.
photo: Photo. The photo decides the layout: find its calm area and put the text there. Full bleed beats a framed photo; crop tight on the subject, cut limbs between joints, never at them. The subject looks or moves toward the text, not out of the canvas. Never put text over a face or the product. To read text on a busy photo use a soft scrim (gradient angle 180, stops from transparent to the photo's own dark colour at 40-70% opacity, over the third that holds the text), not a box. One strong photo beats a collage. The user's real photo beats any stock photo: ask for it.
depth: Depth and details. Three planes at most: background, subject, type. An overlap is either clear (15% or more) or absent: no edges that almost touch. Elements that reach an edge bleed past it; do not stop them a few pixels short. One corner radius, one stroke width and one shadow style for the whole design. Shadows are soft and tinted with the background colour, never default grey. Every decorative element must carry meaning (from the subject's world); if it only fills space, remove it. No catalogue icon in the right style? Draw it with draw_svg: a few flat shapes on a 24 px viewBox, one stroke width, flat colours picked from the design, like a pictogram set (a folder = a body rectangle plus a small lighter tab), rather than a mismatched emoji. Keep draw_svg to icons, badges, separators and simple custom shapes: detailed illustrations drawn as SVG look amateur, use a photo or a catalogue illustration instead.
finish: Finish. Before export: remove one element (the design is better with less); check alignment edge by edge on the grid; check the thumbnail test; check that nothing important sits in the top 13% or bottom 15% of a story. Iterate on what exists (size, crop, spacing) before adding anything new. Look at a preview after every batch of changes. Paper grounds (cream, kraft, off-white) read as printed with background grain 6-10; flat digital looks keep grain 0.
avoid: Avoid generic reflexes unless the brief asks for them: photo in a frame centred with a centred title and subtitle under it; everything centred in one column; an emoji or a sticker as the main visual; identical rounded cards and pill buttons; small spaced caps label above the title; one word of the title in italic or accent colour to look designed; 'A - B - C' chains; dots, grids or stripes as filler backgrounds; cream + high-contrast serif + terracotta; black + one acid accent; glass cards; decorative gradients.
types: Type picker: match the brief against one archetype, then read its style_guide('type:...') rule and follow it. sale words (-30 %, offer, promo, discount, sale, price, soldes, reduction, prix) -> type:sale-offer. invitation (invite, birthday, wedding, RSVP, party, invitation, anniversaire, mariage, soiree, fete) -> type:event-invitation. quote (quote, mantra, affirmation, citation) -> type:quote. launch (launch, new, drop, perfume, skincare, lancement, nouveau, nouvelle, parfum, creme, cosmetique) -> type:product-launch. luxury (luxury, minimal, black, gold, luxe, noir, dore) -> type:minimal-luxury. collage (moodboard, scrapbook, polaroid, memories, recap, souvenirs, vacances) -> type:collage. big-text poster (poster, black friday, lineup, festival, affiche) -> type:typographic-poster. concert or opening (concert, opening, news, event, ouverture, evenement, inauguration) -> type:announcement. price list (menu, price list, food truck, salon, classes, carte, tarifs, cours) -> type:menu-list. review (review, testimonial, stars, avis, temoignage) -> type:testimonial.
type:sale-offer: Sale offer. Fits: a price cut, promo code or limited deal. Layout: one hero figure (-30 %, price, code) at 3x body size minimum, top or center third; one supporting line; one verb-led call to action last on the reading path, bottom third. Never more than 2 inks + 1 accent reserved for the figure. Type: a condensed display (Anton, Archivo Black, Bebas Neue, Oswald) for the figure, a neutral sans (Inter, Montserrat, Figtree) for the rest. Colours: flat or full-bleed photo with a scrim behind the figure. Ingredients: starburst or badge shape for the figure, grain under 25. Checklist: figure readable at 270 px wide; price and condition together; contrast 4.5:1 behind every word; safe zone respected.
type:event-invitation: Event invitation. Fits: birthday, wedding, private party, opening. Layout: centered card (60-80 % width) on a photo or flat wash; script title, then date + time + place as three short centered lines, then one divider ornament. Type: a formal script (Pinyon Script, Parisienne, Allura) for names, letterspaced caps sans (Montserrat, Cormorant Garamond caps) for the details. Colours: cream or blush wash + one deep tone + one metallic accent (gold). Ingredients: arches or zellige pattern at low weight, thin divider line, grain under 20. Checklist: date, time and place all present; script 72 px or more; ornament carries the event theme; nothing over faces.
type:quote: Quote. Fits: a saying, affirmation or motto. Layout: centered block, side margins 12-15 %, generous calm above and below; 2-4 words per line broken by meaning; attribution in small caps under it. Type: one serif with character (Fraunces, DM Serif Display, Lora, Cormorant Garamond) for the quote, the same family or a quiet sans for the attribution at half size. Colours: paper wash + one ink. Ingredients: paper texture image under 40 % blend multiply, or grain under 20. Checklist: 25 words or fewer; no single word alone on the last line; quote size at least 3x the attribution; contrast 4.5:1; box height fits every line (size x lineHeight x line count, the lint flags overflow so grow the box).
type:product-launch: Product launch. Fits: a new product, scent, drop or flavour. Layout: product visual on one strong third (40-60 % of the canvas), name at 3x body on the calm third, at most 3 benefit fragments. Type: a modern grotesque (Space Grotesk, Sora, Bricolage Grotesque) for the name, a soft serif (Instrument Serif, Cormorant) for one accent word at most. Colours: pulled from the product (its dark, its light, one strong colour). Ingredients: soft linear gradient glow behind the product, grain under 25. Checklist: product never cropped awkwardly; name and product on opposite thirds; 3 benefits maximum; no pill CTA unless asked.
type:minimal-luxury: Minimal luxury. Fits: high-end brand, quiet announcement. Layout: at least 50 % calm; type small and centered or bottom-anchored; one thin rule as the only ornament. Type: a light serif (Cormorant Garamond, Libre Baskerville) or a tracked-out grotesque (Montserrat, Outfit) in caps with +5 to +10 % spacing. Colours: near-black or warm charcoal + warm white + one muted metallic. Ingredients: none, or grain under 15. Checklist: calm really empty (no texture under the type); one accent only; thin rules 2-4 px; thumbnail reads one word.
type:collage: Collage and scrapbook. Fits: memories, recap, moodboard, travel. Layout: 3-6 photo frames tilted -6 to +6 degrees on a paper wash, overlapping clearly (15 % or more) or not touching; one handwritten caption. Type: a hand (Caveat, Gochi Hand, Shadows Into Light) for the caption, a neutral sans for date or place. Colours: paper wash + the photos' own colours. Ingredients: translucent tape rects on frame corners, photo cornerRadius 0-8, grain 20-40. Checklist: every frame inside the canvas; tape only on corners; one caption, never one per photo; frame edges bleed or clear the canvas edge, never almost touch it.
type:typographic-poster: Typographic poster. Fits: sales week, lineup, festival, big announcement in words. Layout: stacked giant lines edge to edge, line height 0.9-1.05, one line rotated or badge for the date. Type: ONE condensed family (Anton, Oswald, Archivo Black, Barlow Condensed), contrast through size only. Colours: two inks on flat, or one ink on photo with scrim. Checklist: run check_design after every batch (wrap is the classic failure); one item per line once a wrap has bitten; tracking negative only on lines without spaces.
type:announcement: Concert and opening announcement. Fits: concert, gig, store opening, news. Layout: small caps kicker on top, giant title middle, solid date-and-place bar at the bottom. Type: a grotesque or slab (Space Grotesk, Bitter, Arvo, Zilla Slab) for the title, a mono (Space Mono, Cutive Mono, IBM Plex Mono) for the details bar. Colours: dark flat + one loud accent, or duotone photo. Checklist: what, where and when all present; date bar contrast 4.5:1; artist or headline name biggest; doors time if it is a concert; the page foot is designed (the date bar anchors the bottom — never trail off mid-page).
type:menu-list: Menu and price list. Fits: food truck, salon, classes, services. Layout: script heading centered, items left with prices right on one vertical line, a clean gap between dish and price (the engine has no dotted leaders), sections of 7 items at most. Type: a readable script (Pinyon Script, Allura) for headings at 90 px or more, a text serif or sans (Lora, Figtree, Outfit) at 30 px minimum for items. Colours: paper + one ink + one accent for prices. Ingredients: hairline section dividers, grain under 15. Checklist: all prices on the same x; body never under 30 px; leaders evenly dotted; each section has a heading; the page foot is designed (photo strip, hours block, or a deliberate calm zone — never trail off mid-page); check_design score addressed before export.
type:testimonial: Testimonial. Fits: review, guest or client quote with a name. Layout: stars or giant quote mark, then the quote, then a round avatar with name and role. Type: an italic serif (Lora italic, Cormorant italic) for the quote, a quiet sans for the name. Colours: calm wash + one ink + gold only for real stars. Ingredients: circle-masked avatar photo, star shapes. Checklist: show only the rating the client gave; avatar 120 px or more; name plus role or business; quote under 40 words.
